text: Nestlé S.A.'s 2025 Annual Review shows its share capital split between 'Institutions' (74%) and 'Private Shareholders' (26%) — a broad, dispersed base, with no single controlling or state shareholder named anywhere in the report.

source.name: Nestlé S.A.: Annual Review 2025
source.quote: Share capital by investor type, long-term evolution... Institutions 74%... Private Shareholders 26%
